geometry_bands.source_anchor: summoned autonomous pet positioned into enemy packs as a disposable mobile bomb ('Blight Fiend pet summon positioned into enemy packs'; 'disposable-bomber pet whose corpse is the payload'). PET DELIVERY IS THE ENGINE GAP (summoner-deferral, §A pet row): the follow/companion summon has NO placement-at-target-position language, so geometry is null-honest per the gapped-pet two-lane ruling. Element shadow: acid damage on a Necromancer corruption pet (Ghol converts Vitality->Acid); §1 acid = earth(nature/venom) OR shadow(necro-corruption) -- necro-summon corruption register chosen, fidelity-noted. NO ailment: acid is DAMAGE-typed (via Ghol conversion), no 'poison' status named in fetched text (§0.1).

the pet's death detonates in a burst around its death location ('mobile bomb; explosion on death hits enemies in radius around pet death location'; 'small-radius-explosion-on-death'). ring carries the burst-around-a-point identity (phrase-book nova/burst -> ring); this is the DAMAGE PAYLOAD of the gapped pet -- distinct attested shape (pet-death-payload), filed as its own docket-candidate per §A pet-row trap note. No status named.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PET-CORE kit -> GAP (summoner-deferral, §A pet row): the loop-verb IS summon-position-explode, and autonomous-combatant delivery is deferred by engine design. Gapped-pet two-lane geometry ruling: the pet is a follow/companion (no placement-at-target language) -> null geometry honest for the summon; the death-explosion is a real burst payload -> ring. on-defender-death trigger models the corpse-is-the-payload identity. Pet-death-payload ('mobile bomb; explosion on death') is a DISTINCT attested shape -> own docket-candidate (per §A pet-row trap note: 'if the shape stands on its own fetched language'). Ghol's Malice set converts Vitality->Acid ON the pet (pet-stat lane != player-stat lane -- never map player-scaling onto pet payload). Element shadow (necro-corruption acid); the earth/venom branch is the alternative, noted. PROXY_FISSION = closest T4 to the disposable-splitting-bomber-pet identity, but it lands as a GAP question (autonomous-combatant delivery unbuilt), not a clean capstone. No status attestable.
